scenario: An e-commerce logistics coordinator evaluates freight carriers for a high-value product shipment lane. They use carrier performance scorecard data to score candidates, calculate total shipping cost including projected SLA penalty offsets from past late-delivery incidents, and generate a carrier selection recommendation report for procurement approval.
info_flow: carrier-relationship-management evaluates carrier performance scorecards and recommends a primary carrier → financial-calculator computes total lane cost (linehaul + FSC + SLA penalty credits) for each candidate → reporting generates a procurement recommendation report for sign-off.
